faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do my customers need to download an app?
faq.a1: No. AmoMisClientes uses PWA technology: your customers install the app directly from the browser in 2 taps, no App Store or Play Store needed.
faq.q2: Does the app show my logo and colors?
faq.a2: Yes. You configure your full brand identity: logo, home screen icon, app colors. Your customers see your brand, not ours.
faq.q3: Do I need special hardware or a tablet at the register?
faq.a3: No. You generate the QR from your own phone or your employee's. No extra hardware investment.
faq.a4: Yes. The Base plan includes 1 location, Standard and Pro up to 5. Each location has its own address and map pin.
faq.a5: Via Stripe with credit or debit card. Monthly billing, no commitment.
faq.a6: Yes. Cancel anytime from your dashboard. Service stays active until the end of the paid period.
faq.q7: What happens to my data if I cancel?
faq.a7: Your data and your customers' data are kept for 90 days. We never share or use business or customer data with third parties.
faq.q8: Can I integrate with my billing system?
faq.a8: Yes. The Pro plan includes a basic API/Webhook to connect with your POS or ERP and add points automatically.
faq.q9: Does it work for businesses with customers who speak another language?
faq.a9: Yes. The customer app supports multiple languages: Spanish, English and Portuguese. Ideal for tourist areas.
